module.purpose: Central Zod schema and validation utility module for the Cal.com Prisma package. It defines reusable schemas for event type metadata, booking responses/cancellation, user/team metadata, org settings, recordings, signup/email validation, and helper functions for schema transformation (denullish, entries, fromEntries, optionToValue). It also re-declares lightweight enums (Frequency, BookerLayouts, BillingPeriod) to avoid importing the heavy Prisma client.
module.summary: This file is a shared validation layer built on Zod that underpins Cal.com's API and data-validation flows. It exports schemas for event type metadata (including managed event unlocked fields, booker layouts, confirmation thresholds), booking request/response payloads (responses, cancellation, confirmation, seat data), user and team metadata (conferencing app defaults, Stripe subscription fields, org migration info), organization settings, custom inputs, event locations, recurring event rules, and Daily video recordings. It includes utility type helpers like ZodDenullish and runtime helpers denullish/denullishShape/entries/fromEntries, plus generic parser factories (optionToValueSchema, getParserWithGeneric). Enum re-implementations (Frequency, BookerLayouts, BillingPeriod) avoid importing the full Prisma client bundle. Validation of booking responses is dynamic elsewhere; this file only covers static schemas. Signup validation integrates password rules via isPasswordValid and email regex.
module.businessContext: Serving Cal.com's scheduling platform, this file validates core booking and event configuration data across API routes and client forms. If it fails, event creation, booking acceptance/cancellation, signup, and org onboarding lose input validation, risking corrupted metadata and invalid bookings.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Cancelling a booking without providing either id or uid is rejected.
moduleContractTests.then: result.success === false with message "At least one of the following required: 'id', 'uid'."
moduleContractTests.rationale: Cancellation must always be attributable to a specific booking.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Cancelling by uid alone is accepted.
CSRF-protected cancel body enforces a 64-character csrfToken.
moduleContractTests.then: result.success === false with message "Invalid CSRF token"

moduleContractTests.scenario: An event-type slug is slugified and must be non-empty after trimming/slugify.
moduleContractTests.then: result.success === false with message "Please enter at least one character"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards slugify collapsing input to empty string.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The iso8601 schema rejects strings that cannot be parsed as dates.
moduleContractTests.then: result.success === false with issue message "Invalid ISO Date"

moduleContractTests.scenario: Numeric strings are coerced to integers; non-numeric strings are rejected.
moduleContractTests.then: "42" parses to 42; "abc" fails with "Not a number"

moduleContractTests.scenario: Signup requires an email matching the shared emailRegex.
Signup password failing password policy yields a zod issue per failed criterion keyed by criterion name.
moduleContractTests.then: result.success === false with issues whose path equals the failed password criterion keys
moduleContractTests.rationale: Issues surface as field-level errors, not a single message.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Strict team metadata rejects subscription ids not prefixed sub_ / si_.
moduleContractTests.then: result.success === false with message "subscriptionId must start with 'sub_'"

moduleContractTests.scenario: denullish unwraps ZodNullable/ZodOptional down to the inner type.
moduleContractTests.then: result parses "x" successfully (no nullable/optional wrapper behaviour remains)

moduleContractTests.scenario: denullishShape returns an object schema with the same fields but nullability removed.
moduleContractTests.when: denullishShape(z.object({ a: z.string().nullable(), b: z.number().optional() })).parse({ a: "x", b: 1 })

moduleContractTests.scenario: successRedirectUrl accepts only http(s) URLs or empty string, blocking javascript:/mailto: schemes.
moduleContractTests.then: javascript: URL fails; empty string succeeds

export const denullish = <T extends ZodTypeAny>(schema: T): ZodDenullish<T> =>
  (schema instanceof ZodNullable || schema instanceof ZodOptional
    ? denullish((schema._def as ZodNullableDef | ZodOptionalDef).innerType)
    : schema) as ZodDenullish<T>;
